title: Structured Basis Function Networks: Loss-Centric Multi-Hypothesis Ensembles with Controllable Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2509.02792v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ensemble learning and multi-hypothesis prediction are two complementary paradigms for improving predictive performance and robustness. This work introduces the Structured Basis Function Network (s-BFN), a loss-aware ensemble framework that unifies these paradigms through a supervised aggregation mechanism motivated by the loss-induced Bregman-centroid geometry of prediction space. The approach constructs a structured dataset of base predictions and trains a parametric combiner directly against the observed labels, with the centroidal formulation serving as a geometric reference rather than an exact centroid solver, while a diversity-control parameter regulates specialization among predictors. The proposed framework is evaluated across regression and classification tasks, including tabular data, image recognition, and large-scale temporally structured video classification. Empirical results show that s-BFN provides strong performance

translated_title: 结构化基函数网络：以损失为中心、多样性可控的多假设集成
translated_abstract: 集成学习与多假设预测是提升预测性能与鲁棒性的两种互补范式。本工作提出了结构化基函数网络，这是一种损失感知的集成框架，通过受预测空间中损失诱导的Bregman质心几何启发的监督聚合机制，将这两种范式统一起来。该方法构建了由基础预测组成的结构化数据集，并直接针对观测标签训练参数化组合器，其中质心公式仅作为几何参考而非精确的质心求解器，同时通过一个多样性控制参数调节预测器之间的专门化程度。该框架在回归与分类等多种任务上进行了评估，包括表格数据、图像识别以及大规模时序结构视频分类。实证结果表明，s-BFN提供了强大而优异的性能。
tldr: 本文提出结构化基函数网络，通过受Bregman质心几何启发的损失感知监督聚合机制与可调的多样性控制参数，将集成学习与多假设预测统一在同一框架中，在回归、图像识别和大规模视频分类等任务上均取得优异表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Structured Basis Function Network (s-BFN), a loss-aware ensemble framework that unifies ensemble learning and multi-hypothesis prediction via supervised aggregation motivated by Bregman-centroid geometry, with a controllable diversity parameter achieving strong performance across regression, image recognition, and large-scale video classification tasks.
